prompt: Batch17 isolated source candidate. Exact generation requests, all rejected variants and SHA checks preserved. All source bodies accounted; no raw PNG changes, exclusions, mirrored or duplicate frames. Newly authored reference-based source, not recovered SPX. Native QA staging does NOT grant approval.

review.notes: Provisional stage inputs: reference model, explicitly authored eight directions and all five nominal motion roles, strict full-source geometry/uniqueness/clipping pass. Actual gait exchange, contact timing and cross-role anatomy remain separate SOURCE_HOLD visual gates. Positive stage flags never substitute for completion approval.

sheets.scale_review_note: Provisional ONE whole-source canvas; no per-phase scaling or PNG edits. All gnoll views use common neutral64 before max-living display normalization, leaving room for the poleaxe. Queen neutral/recovery calibration, kneeling death source uses a whole-sheet standing equivalent. Actual Main anatomy/gait/contact review required; not production approval.
